newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 6.612 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 6.612 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton production reached 6.612 million 375-lb bales in the 1996/97 (July/June) crop year to December 15, against 6.606 million bales in the same period a year ago, ginners said on Thursday.

The private Pakistan Cotton Ginners' Association said spinning mills had purchased 4.876 million bales against 4.539 million bales last year. Exporters had bought 3,300 bales compared to 495,730 bales last year.
It said 952,276 bales were lying unsold with ginning factories and 780,571 un-ginned press bales were in stock with them on December 15, 1996.
This compared to a total stock figure of 1.571 million bales in the same period last year.
